actions.script: timelineFound = false; rowList = []; planRows = [] const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const theMode = ['items', 'plan', 'portfolio'].includes(mode) ? mode : 'items' let project = rootWorkEffortId || null if (!project && theMode === 'items') project = Array.from(ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.WorkItemServices.get#ProjectOptions').parameters({memberOnly: true}).call()?.projectList || [])[0]?.key || null if (!project && theMode === 'items') return const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.PlanningServices.get#Timeline').parameters({mode: theMode, rootWorkEffortId: project}).call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() const timeline = out.timeline if (!timeline || timeline.notAvailable) return timelineFound = true title = theMode === 'portfolio' ? L('Projects') : (timeline.project ? timeline.project.workEffortName + ' (' + timeline.project.workEffortId + ')' : L('Roadmap')) const fmt = (day) => day ? ec.l10n.format(ec.l10n.parseTimestamp(day + ' 12:00:00.000', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'), 'MMM d') : '' const span = (first, last) => first && last && first !== last ? fmt(first) + ' – ' + fmt(last) : fmt(last || first) const names = {} for (const row of timeline.rowList || []) names[row.workEffortId] = row.workEffortId const waits = {} for (const link of timeline.dependencyList || []) (waits[link.workEffortId] || (waits[link.workEffortId] = [])).push(link.toWorkEffortId + (link.lagDays ? ' +' + link.lagDays + 'd' : '') + (link.violated ? ' (' + L('late') + ')' : '')) rowList = Array.from(timeline.rowList || []).map((row) => ({workEffortId: row.workEffortId, url: row.url || '', name: ' '.repeat(Math.min(row.depth || 0, 6)) + (row.workEffortName || row.workEffortId), whenText: row.childCount && !row.startDay && !row.dueDay ? span(row.spanStartDay, row.spanDueDay) : (span(row.startDay, row.dueDay) || L('No dates')), progressText: (row.progress || 0) + '%', statusLabel: row.statusLabel || '', waitsText: (waits[row.workEffortId] || []).join(', ')})) planRows = Array.from(theMode === 'items' ? (timeline.planItemList || []) : []).map((plan) => ({name: plan.workEffortName, kind: plan.kindLabel, whenText: span(plan.startDay, plan.dueDay), statusLabel: plan.statusLabel, progressText: (plan.percentDone || 0) + '%'})) dependencyCount = (timeline.dependencyList || []).length
